comment: E32/GDPR: registry of which Prisma models hold personal data subject to a right-to-erasure request, and what treatment applies. Read by SaasPortalGdprComplianceService.loadPiiRegistry(). Every model here must exist in that service's prismaModelMap. 'erase' hard-deletes matching rows; 'anonymize' overwrites the fields listed in that service's piiAnonymizeFields with redacted placeholders instead of deleting the row (used where the row itself must survive for referential/financial-record reasons); 'retain-legal-hold' is logged and skipped.

User.rationale: User rows are referenced by createdBy/updatedBy/assignee fields across most business records; hard-deleting would break referential history. Anonymizing the identifying fields satisfies erasure while preserving the audit trail's structural integrity.

Organization.rationale: An Organization can be the tenant's own customer/vendor entity referenced by many financial records; anonymize rather than delete to preserve those records.

Employee.rationale: Employee records are subject-specific HR data with no cross-tenant referential requirement once the employment relationship ends and any statutory retention period has passed.

Customer.rationale: Customer rows are referenced by Invoice/Order/Payment records that must be retained for statutory financial record-keeping; anonymize the PII fields rather than deleting the row.

Vendor.rationale: Vendor rows are referenced by PurchaseOrder/Payment records that must be retained for statutory financial record-keeping; anonymize the PII fields rather than deleting the row.

Contact.rationale: CRM contact records have no independent statutory retention requirement once erasure is requested.

Lead.rationale: Sales lead records have no independent statutory retention requirement once erasure is requested.

POSLoyaltyMember.rationale: Loyalty program membership records have no independent statutory retention requirement once erasure is requested.

Applicant.rationale: Recruiting applicant records have no independent statutory retention requirement once erasure is requested (subject to any jurisdiction-specific hiring-record minimums, tracked separately via DataRetentionPolicy).

CustomerPortalUser.rationale: Portal login accounts have no independent statutory retention requirement once erasure is requested.

VendorPortalUser.rationale: Portal login accounts have no independent statutory retention requirement once erasure is requested.
